name: DS Cluster D18: Crypto Ticker Conventions (is_asset_ref + crypto_pairs)
description: Tests: is_asset_ref with bare crypto ticker (not ^prefix or X: prefix), asset_class filtering, crypto_pairs bare ticker, conditional logic per asset.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D18: Crypto Ticker Conventions
# =============================================================================
# is_asset_ref uses BARE tickers — no ^prefix, no X: runtime symbols.
# crypto_pairs also uses bare tickers.

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
vol = src.v

# === is_asset_ref BY TICKER (bare — CORRECT) ===
is_btc = is_asset_ref(ticker="^BTCUSD")()
is_eth = is_asset_ref(ticker="^ETHUSD")()

# === is_asset_ref BY ASSET CLASS ===
is_crypto = is_asset_ref(asset_class=AssetClassUI.Crypto)()

# === CONDITIONAL LOGIC: different treatment per asset ===
# Apply different moving average periods per asset
fast_ma = ma(period=10, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_ma = ma(period=30, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# BTC gets longer lookback, ETH gets shorter
ma_signal = where(is_btc, slow_ma, fast_ma)

# === RETURNS ===
ret = returns(close)
cum_ret = cumulative()(ret)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="Close with Conditional MA (BTC=30d, ETH=10d)",
    category="Conventions",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.White),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Conditional MA", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, ma_signal))

xy_lines(
    title="Cumulative Returns by Asset",
    category="Conventions",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Cum Return", color=Color.Green)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Flat")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cum_ret)

histogram(
    title="Return Distribution (All Crypto Assets)",
    category="Conventions",
    bins=40
)(ret)
